messages:
rachel: hey folks, rachel here — first day! i'm wiring up a private endpoint for a model eval. quick map: who owns VPC/subnet allocations vs who issues service creds? also need to know the preferred escalation flow for infra vs eng-sre during a canary rollout. thanks! :wave:

onboarding-bot: welcome @rachel! Start with the onboarding network doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/network. Use the infra-access Jira template for resource requests.

tom: eng-infra owns VPC/subnet allocation, route tables, and peering. For private endpoints mention project name, desired CIDR, and region in the vpc-request. Example: `Project: search-evals; Env: private; Request: subnet-assign; CIDR: 10.250.10.0/24`.

ops: eng-sre handles service runbooks and paging triage. Short rule: page `eng-sre-oncall` for service-level degradations (errors, latency spikes). Page `infra-ops` for capacity, network flaps, or provisioning failures. For canaries, page eng-sre first with links to dashboards and the infra ticket.

infra-dns: DNS and certs are handled by infra-dns. Include hostname, internal/external flag, and cert lifetime in your infra ticket. We'll provision certs after subnets are ready. Ticket snippet we prefer:
```
Hostname: eval-private.model.redwood.internal
Type: internal
Cert: internal-ca
Owner: rachel
Canary: yes (15%)
```

finance: billing/dashboard access requires cost-center and approver. Request `billing-read` via ID portal (https://id.redwood.internal) and tag `finance-ops` on the infra ticket for Dedicated capacity requests. Dedicated reservations also need infra-lead + finance signoff.

rachel: got it — for paging, is Slack page OK or do we call phone numbers for initial alerts? also trying to avoid noisy pages during low-risk canary.

ops: prefer Slack pager (`/pager eng-sre-oncall <one-line>`) for initial triage. Phone/voice only for P0s or if a page is unacknowledged for >10 mins. For canaries: include runbook link, Prom/Grafana links, and metric thresholds in the page to reduce noise.

tom: one more tip — when you create the infra ticket, include an eval baseline and perf targets. eng-sre will wire up regression alarms if you add those.

rachel: thanks all! i'll open infra-access with subnet + dns + cert details, request billing-read, and cc eng-sre + finance. appreciate the map :thumbsup:
